evidence.excerpt: SE3 Labs evaluated GPT6-Astra controlling a robot to put one LEGO brick in a box. Two approaches: Model writes code upfront, then runs it: 6/20 success. Model reasoning live during the task: 18/20. Keeping the model in the loop is not cheap though: ~$2.68 per episode.
